name: neo-dsh
description: Neo DSH: my own DeepSeek Harness desktop suite — Electron shell, client plugins, agent preset and the profile they ship with.

scripts.start: pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop run start
scripts.pack: pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run resources && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron-builder --win
